title: ChatGPT, Cursor and Vercel: A Fast AI Website Workflow

facts.fact: The blog post was published on January 17, 2026.
The page lists its reading time as 4 minutes.
The page describes the AI website workflow as having four steps: plan the site, draft copy and code with ChatGPT, build in Cursor, and deploy from GitHub to Vercel with previews.
facts.quote: A four-step AI website workflow: plan the site, draft copy and code with ChatGPT, build it in Cursor, then deploy from GitHub to Vercel with previews.

facts.fact: The page states that Vercel automatically builds a site every time changes are pushed to the linked GitHub repository.
facts.quote: Vercel automatically builds your site every time you push changes to your GitHub repository.
